notes: TMR Queensland design sheet (Q-series book / TC-series), colour drawing 'not to scale' with a lettered dimension table; every dimension from the sheet, AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheets give no letter widths, so there is no width check. Q-series sheet W3-Q01 'Signals ahead' warning sign (1995/2019, rev B; note: only at emergency service facilities per AS 1742.14 cl 7.1(a)). Size A 600 diamond generated (B 750 also tabled): a 600 side drawn as the bounding square 848.53, r 40, b 8 yellow edge + c 16 black border (separate spans on the sheet). Symbol box from the detail chains: width h 20 + g 92 + f 28 + e 56 + f 28 + g 92 + h 20 = 336 = 2 x y 168 (y each side of the vertical centreline), height n 24 + m 44 + q 100 + f 28 + q 100 + m 44 + n 24 = 364 = d (x 182 above the centreline, so centred on the sign): box x 256.27, y 242.27. The symbol is the sheet PDF's own vector paths (tools/symbols/qld_w3-q01_signals.svg, vec2sym, not traced): black housing with the two lenses as yellow-filled circles (the sheet draws them in the sign's yellow); drawn 344.9 x 375.3 on the sheet's 600 sign, i.e. 2.6 % larger than the tabled box, scaled into it. Black on retroreflective yellow.
